findings.current: “Friend, my ass. That brat’s got no filter when he talks to his elders.”
findings.defect: Jeok is addressing the Thunderbolt Saber King, who has just called him a friend; the draft instead sounds as though Jeok is criticizing his Disciple.
findings.rationale: 한참 어린놈 refers to the younger man Jeok is arguing with, and 웃어른 refers to Jeok himself.
findings.replacement: “Friend, my ass. You’ve got a lot of nerve talking to someone so much older than you like that.”
findings.source: 친구는 니미럴. 한참 어린놈이 웃어른한테 못하는 말이 없네.

findings.current: “That’s why I came to you right away.
findings.defect: The draft makes the Thunderbolt Saber King go to Taekyung, though he was waiting inside and had Taekyung brought to him.
findings.rationale: 찾은 describes seeking Taekyung out, not physically coming to him.
findings.replacement: “That’s why I asked for you right away.

findings.current: Not even if it came from the Thunderbolt Saber King, a man he’d spent decades growing to hate—and who was now on the verge of death.
findings.defect: “Growing to hate” erases the reluctant affection in 미운 정.
findings.rationale: 미운 정 describes affection formed through a long, contentious relationship, not mounting hatred.
findings.replacement: Not even if it came from the Thunderbolt Saber King, a man he’d spent decades trading barbs with and grown fond of despite himself—and who was now on the verge of death.
findings.source: 설령 그 제안을 한 이가, 수십여 년간 미운 정을 쌓아 온 끝에 죽음을 목전에 둔 벽력도왕이라 할지라도.

findings.current: The desperate situation. The martial prowess Jin Taekyung had built up as a martial artist.
findings.defect: The fragments omit the stated comparison between the earlier transfer and the present one.
findings.rationale: These are the two respects in which 그 당시와 지금의 차이—the difference between then and now—is clear.
findings.replacement: The circumstances were different. So was the martial prowess Jin Taekyung had achieved since then.
findings.source: 위급했던 상황도. 진태경이 한 사람의 무인으로서 이룩해 낸 무위도.

findings.current: then watched the two men, joined at the Great Pouch Acupoint, with a gaze sunk deep in thought.
findings.rationale: 거궐혈 names the Juque, or Great Palace, acupoint; the draft’s anatomical name is inaccurate.
findings.replacement: then watched the two men, joined at the Great Palace acupoint, with a deeply troubled gaze.
findings.source: 거궐혈(巨闕穴)을 통해 맞닿은 두 사람을 바라보았다.

summary: Several lines change who acts or speaks, and one misstates Jeok Cheongang’s relationship with the Thunderbolt Saber King.
